hana: dropping fresh hero + benchmark blurb for the Sparkline Playbook launch post. quick copy pass and legal quick-pass please.

devon: can you share the perf sheet? PMs want p95 by workload and the raw CSV for the methods appendix.

hana: sheet here: https://tiny.redwood/sparkline-bench (view-only). proposed hero: "Up to 4x lower per-token inference cost and ~65% lower 95th-percentile latency versus our previous hosted baseline."

marta: tiny nit 1 say "per-token inference cost" (explicit) and use "up to" (we already have it). maybe add "for representative gen and chat workloads" to be clear.

hana: updated: "Up to 4x lower per-token inference cost and ~65% lower 95th-percentile latency for representative gen and chat workloads vs our previous hosted baseline."

devon: webinar ops 1 we should tie this to a live trace on slide 4. target Wed 9/8 9am PT. reserve 300 seats + waitlist?

hana: yes Wed 9/8 9am PT, reserve 300 seats + waitlist. add CTA to register and to grab the public notebook.

legal-bot: Automated check: flagged absolute numeric phrasing. Recommend adding methodology footnote and linking public notebook. Suggested language: "Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs on representative gen and chat workloads; see methodology tab and public notebook for harness, datasets, warmup, and config." Manual review required for the phrase "Up to 4x" and numeric latency claim; legal ops will reply in-thread within 48h with final signoff or edits.

hana: inserting suggested methodology line and notebook link. Draft excerpt now:

"Today were launching Sparkline Playbook  a serving profile tuned for mixed gen + chat workloads that can deliver up to 4x lower per-token inference cost and ~65% lower 95th-percentile latency for representative gen and chat workloads compared to our previous hosted baseline. Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs on representative gen and chat workloads; see methodology tab and public notebook for harness, datasets, warmup, and config. Register to join the live demo on Wed 9/8 at 9am PT and download the public benchmark notebook."
